module.name: D-Modem
module.description: Software data modems and fax for your calls with D-Modem: V.21 to V.34, and V.90 to a dial-up modem over G.711. Profiles send a call's data to a BBS or another server, or to a program such as pppd, and each is a destination. Needs app_dmodem.so in Asterisk, or dmodem-ari beside it.
module.changelog: *16.0.2* Dialling out with a profile (page and fwconsole dmodem dial), Backup and Restore, fwconsole dmodem export/import *16.0.1* Profiles as destinations, dmodem.conf, a fax destination, dmodem-ari as an engine, the line check
